answer: In AI-agent economies, one sybil-resistant mechanism requires every identity to maintain a minimum stake locked in a shared canyon of scarce on-chain compute credits that slowly erode. An attacker spinning up fake agents must continuously fund this porous karst of economic barriers for each one, and any effort to jetty a large cluster of identities across the network multiplies the capital locked until the cumulative cost exceeds any possible reward, rendering mass forgery unprofitable.
